name: Blinding Faith
body:
School illusion (glamer); Level inquisitor 1

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range self
Target you
Duration 1 min./level (D)

DESCRIPTION

You call upon your deity or faith to make you invisible to adherents of other faiths. This functions as the spell invisibility except it only works against adherents to a particular deity or faith, declared when the spell is cast.

This does not work on pantheons or groups of deities.

This can also be used to target atheists or spiritualists.

Blinding Faith, Greater

School illusion (glamer); Level inquisitor 3
Duration 1 round/level (D.

This spell functions as blinding faith except instead of creating an invisibility effect, it grants the benefits of greater invisibility.

Blinding Faith, Greater

School illusion (glamer); Level inquisitor 3

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels.

Targets one creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart

This spell functions as blinding faith except as noted above.
